description: This Java source file defines the UpdateService class, a WearableListenerService implementation that handles data layer events (specifically DataItem changes) for a Wear OS application. It manages the connection to the Google API client, processes incoming data for location updates, and deletes data items after processing.

classes.name: UpdateService
classes.description: A WearableListenerService that monitors data layer changes related to location tracking, handles connection to GoogleApiClient, processes incoming location data, and manages deletion of data items.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the GoogleApiClient, connects it, and retrieves the data manager from the application context.

methods.name: onDataChanged
methods.description: Handles incoming data change events, extracts location data, adds it to the data manager, and deletes processed data items.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Callback invoked when GoogleApiClient connects; triggers deletion of queued data items.

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Handles suspended connection; no implementation here.

methods.name: onConnectionFailed
methods.description: Handles connection failure by logging an error.

methods.name: onResult
methods.description: Callback invoked after attempting to delete data items, logs failures.
